text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Setting down the burden she had carried 
alone as an older sister, Ines Fujin ran 
in the Osaka Hai purely... and genuinely 
enjoying it from the bottom of her heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having freed herself from the feelings 
weighing her down, Ines Fujin crossed the 
finish line with a brilliantly bright 
smile.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I want to live up to the dreams of the 
people who support me even more. After 
finishing the race, that feeling grew even 
stronger within Ines Fujin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm all for her wish to run in the 
Takarazuka Kinen, where popular Umamusume 
gather. Let's give her our full support!
